label: Slideshow Hero
purpose: Full-width hero image/video slideshow with heading, text and up to two buttons per slide
_notes:
At least 2 slides. Each slide's 'heading' is inline_richtext (no

tags); 'text' is richtext and MUST be wrapped in

tags. This section's 'slide' block is distinct from the older slideshow section's slide — it is rendered inline by slideshow-hero.liquid itself, not via a shared blocks/slide.liquid file, so use exactly the fields listed on the slide block below.
